item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\n\\ndef check(req,pol,expected):\\n    r0=copy.deepcopy(req); p0=copy.deepcopy(pol)\\n    got=evaluate(req,pol)\\n    assert got==expected,(got,expected)\\n    assert req==r0 and pol==p0\\n    assert set(got)=={'ok','value','reason'}\\n\\np={'edges':{'a>b':{},'b>c':{'role':'op'},'c>d':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}\\ncheck({'from':'x','to':'y'},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'})\\ncheck({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'bad','attempts':False},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'})\\ncheck({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'op','attempts':False},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})\\ncheck({'from':'c','to':'d','attempts':-1},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})\\ncheck({'from':'c','to':'d','attempts':0},p,{'ok':True,'value':'d','reason':'ok'})\\ncheck({'from':'c','to':'d','attempts':1},p,{'ok':True,'value':'d','reason':'ok'})\\ncheck({'from':'c','to':'d','attempts':2},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})\\ncheck({'from':'a','to':'b'},p,{'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'})\\npolicy=json.load(open('policy.json')); requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json'))\\nassert report==[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]\\nprint('all checks passed')\"]}"}
